title: Attraction hours and transport prompts
preconditions: Seed attraction with hours; Zoomobile or dual-role attraction/transport if available.
dateUnderTest: Visit date when attraction is open if possible.
cleanup: Clear or leave a simple itinerary.

steps.name: Add attraction
steps.do: Add an attraction in the wizard.

steps.name: Schedule outside hours
steps.do: After finish, schedule it outside operating hours.
steps.expect: Snap to nearest valid time and/or warning.

steps.name: Confirm snap
steps.expect: Time inside operating window or explicit override noted.

steps.name: Closed-day confirm
steps.do: If visit date is closed for that attraction, attempt add.

steps.name: Attraction also transportation
steps.do: Add Zoomobile (or dual-role) via path that shows **Add as Attraction?**
steps.expect: Prompt appears with scenic vs transport messaging.

steps.name: List representations
steps.expect: Attraction vs transportation representations are distinct and correct.

steps.name: Hours validation bubble
steps.do: If manual time edit exists, enter invalid hours.
